exam.tagline: NASM's science-backed, open-book nutrition coaching credential that lets trainers add habit-based guidance — without practicing dietetics.
exam.description: The NASM Certified Nutrition Coach (NASM-CNC) is a science-backed nutrition coaching credential from the National Academy of Sports Medicine, designed for fitness and wellness professionals who want to guide clients' everyday food choices without crossing into medical nutrition therapy. The exam is 100 multiple-choice questions in 90 minutes, open-book and taken online, with a 70% passing score and up to three attempts. There are no prerequisites to enroll, and the fully online, self-paced program is updated for 2026. The CNC is a specialization rather than a third-party-accredited certification, so it is ideal for adding a coaching revenue stream alongside a personal training or group fitness credential.

quickAnswer.summary: The NASM Certified Nutrition Coach (NASM-CNC) is an online nutrition coaching specialization from NASM. After the self-paced course you take a 100-question, 90-minute, open-book exam and must score at least 70% (up to three attempts within your 365-day enrollment).
advantages: Science-backed curriculum from the #1 name in fitness education (NASM)
Open-book, online, timed 90-minute exam — no trip to a test center
No prerequisites; fully self-paced and 100% digital
Pairs naturally with NASM-CPT or AFAA-CPT to add a coaching revenue stream
Earns 1.9 NASM CEUs, which also count toward other NASM/AFAA renewals

roadmap: Enroll with no prerequisites and pick Self-Study or Premium Self-Study
Complete the online, self-paced course (4–6 weeks typical)
Use practice quizzes to check your understanding
Score 70% or higher within your 3 attempts to pass
Renew every 2 years via the CNC renewal exam
exam.prerequisites: None. NASM states there are no required prerequisites for the Certified Nutrition Coach; anyone may enroll.
exam.eligibility: The CNC is open to all learners — it is especially aimed at fitness and wellness professionals such as personal trainers, group fitness instructors, and strength coaches, but no prior certification, degree, or experience is required. You have five years of course access from the date of purchase and must complete the exam within one year of enrollment.

faqs.q: How is the NASM-CNC exam structured?
faqs.a: It is an online, open-book, timed exam of 100 multiple-choice questions with a 90-minute limit. You need a score of 70% or higher and get up to three attempts to pass.
No. NASM lists no required prerequisites for the Certified Nutrition Coach, so anyone can enroll. It pairs naturally with a personal training or group fitness certification but does not require one.

faqs.q: Is the NASM-CNC accredited and does it make me a dietitian?
faqs.a: The CNC is a NASM specialization and is not third-party (NCCA) accredited; the exam is taken online rather than at a testing facility. It does not make you a Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) and stays within a coaching scope of practice — refer medical nutrition needs to an RDN.

faqs.q: What if I don't pass the first time?
faqs.a: You have up to three attempts within your one-year exam enrollment window at no extra charge. If you exhaust the attempts, you can purchase additional retests by contacting NASM.

faqs.q: How do I renew the credential?
faqs.a: The NASM-CNC must be renewed every two years. Per NASM's terms, renewal is done by purchasing and passing the NASM-CNC renewal exam (three attempts, 365-day enrollment). A NASM One membership waives recertification fees.

program.about: The National Academy of Sports Medicine (NASM) is one of the most recognized names in fitness education. Its Certified Nutrition Coach (NASM-CNC) is a fully online, self-paced specialization that teaches evidence-based nutrition coaching, behavior change, and habit building for fitness and wellness professionals. The CNC is a NASM specialization rather than a third-party-accredited certification, and it awards 1.9 NASM CEUs.

registrationSteps.title: Choose your package
registrationSteps.description: Select CNC Self-Study or CNC Premium Self-Study on nasm.org. There are no prerequisites, so you can enroll immediately.

registrationSteps.title: Create your account and pay
registrationSteps.description: Set up your NASM account, choose a one-time payment or a monthly plan (often from ~$49/month), and gain course access for five years.

registrationSteps.title: Complete the coursework
registrationSteps.description: Work through the digital lessons, videos, animations, and downloadable handouts covering nutrition science, behavior change, and practical coaching.

registrationSteps.title: Use the practice quizzes
registrationSteps.description: Check your readiness with the built-in practice quizzes before attempting the final exam.

registrationSteps.title: Take the final exam
registrationSteps.description: Within 365 days of enrollment, take the 100-question, 90-minute, open-book exam online from your computer. Score 70% or higher; you have up to 3 attempts.

registrationSteps.title: Download your certificate
registrationSteps.description: On passing, you receive your digital certificate and badge and earn 1.9 NASM CEUs, which also apply to NASM/AFAA recertifications.

program.proctoring: None. The CNC exam is online and open-book, taken from your own computer within a 90-minute timer. It is not administered at a third-party testing center.
program.retakePolicy: You are allowed up to three (3) exam attempts within your 365-day exam enrollment window at no extra charge. If you do not pass after three attempts, additional retests can be purchased by contacting NASM.
program.recertification: The NASM-CNC must be renewed every two (2) years. Per NASM's terms and conditions, renewal is completed by purchasing and passing the NASM-CNC renewal exam, which offers three attempts and a 365-day enrollment. NASM One membership waives the recertification fee.
program.scoreReporting: Your pass/fail result and score appear on screen immediately after the exam. Your certificate and CEU record are posted to your NASM account.
program.refundPolicy: NASM offers a refund within 14 days of purchase for many products if you are not satisfied (see the NASM refund policy). Once the exam is started or completed, refund eligibility may end; confirm current terms on nasm.org.
program.providersNote: The CNC is delivered directly by NASM online (no external testing vendor). It is a specialization, not an NCCA-accredited certification, and is distinct from the NASM Certified Personal Trainer (NASM-CPT).

orgFaqs.q: Does the NASM-CNC make me a Registered Dietitian?
orgFaqs.a: No. The CNC is a coaching specialization within a defined scope of practice. A Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) requires a master's degree, an ACEND-accredited supervised practice, and passing the CDR registration exam, and can provide medical nutrition therapy.

orgFaqs.q: Can I take the exam from home?
orgFaqs.a: Yes. The CNC exam is online, open-book, and timed at 90 minutes — you take it from your own computer, with no test center or proctor required.

orgFaqs.q: How long do I have to finish?
orgFaqs.a: You have five years of course access from purchase and must complete the exam within one year (365 days) of your enrollment date. Up to three attempts are included.
